title: Lily Takes the Train — version2 storyboard
dialogue_policy: Preserve all 12 original user lines exactly. Existing equal 55/12-second cues are retained; shot sub-beats can change inside each cue.
visual_direction: Mature adult woman; shoulder-length loose dark wavy hair; sage knit pullover, full-length jeans and everyday shoes; warm soft photographic 3D lighting, restrained acting, native-frame animation.
location_convention: Shots 3 and 4 are illustrative destination/schedule cutaways with Lily absent; present action returns home for the 9:00 clock. After shot 10, a clear montage cut advances actual travel to the station. The film is a 55-second story montage, not 55 seconds of real elapsed journey time.

continuity.outfit: One consistent sage pullover, full-length blue jeans and understated shoes.
continuity.bag: Same small cream bag throughout; wallet packed in shot 6, bottle packed in shot 9, phone packed in shot 10; contents never reset.
continuity.phone: Show Anna photo in shot 2, set down; collect in shot 6; timetable in shot 7, set down to free hand; message in shot 10, then pack.
continuity.prop_contact: Test real hand support and grip paths before final animation. No floating props or hidden known contact errors.
continuity.train_safety: Train stationary with open door for boarding; no departure until Lily is safely aboard and doors are closed.

cpu_preview_gate: platform hero frame with same Lily

shots.speaker: Lily
shots.dialogue: Good morning! Today, I am taking the train.
shots.visual: Adult Lily, waist-up left of center, greets the viewer. Her small cream bag, phone and wallet sit on a reachable entry console; soft kitchen/living-room depth is visible behind.

camera.composition: Face at x0.35; eye line y0.28; head-to-waist framing; bag/action space on right

actions: Small open-hand greeting, relaxed elbow and warm smile.
At the end of the line Lily glances toward the phone.
needed_assets: adult Lily in final sage pullover and jeans
critical_checks: Adult face/body silhouette is established in the first frame.
No large repetitive arm swing or permanently surprised eyes.

shots.speaker: Lily
shots.dialogue: I am going to visit my sister, Anna.
shots.location: Home: entry console, Anna contact/photo insert
shots.visual: Over Lily's shoulder, a clearly readable contact/photo of her adult sister Anna fills the phone. A brief warm reaction from Lily links the picture to the relationship.

camera.type: over-shoulder phone close-up, optional reaction reverse
camera.composition: Phone in lower/right central field; Anna photo and name clear; Lily cheek/shoulder gives scale

actions: Lily picks up phone and opens Anna contact/photo.
Show a friendly adult portrait in the same visual style; no extra spoken line.
Lily sets the phone back on the console before the destination cutaways.
needed_assets: Anna contact/photo still with distinct adult appearance
critical_checks: Anna appears on the phone, not as an unexplained second person in Lily's home.
Screen remains readable and fingers actually support the phone.

shots.speaker: Lily
shots.dialogue: She lives in a town called Greenfield.
shots.location: Greenfield: town square or residential station approach
shots.location_role: illustrative destination cutaway; Lily remains at home
shots.visual: Warm morning view of a small town with a readable GREENFIELD sign, modest brick/cream buildings, trees and an inviting residential street. A house/door detail can suggest Anna's home without needing a second animated rig.

camera.composition: Town sign in foreground third; layered street/buildings behind; enough depth to feel like a place

actions: Slow, restrained camera drift or nearly static establishing image.
Keep Lily absent so this reads as a destination illustration, not her physical arrival.
critical_checks: Greenfield spelling matches every later phone and board.
Town scene has readable depth and architecture rather than a flat backdrop.

shots.speaker: Lily
shots.dialogue: My train leaves at ten thirty this morning.
shots.location: Station: departure board and platform/train insert
shots.location_role: illustrative scheduled-service cutaway; Lily remains at home
shots.visual: A legible departure board reads GREENFIELD | 10:30 | PLATFORM 2. Beyond it, a shelter, platform and a stationary regional passenger train establish the trip visually.

camera.type: departure board medium insert with train context
camera.composition: Board in upper/central field, train windows/door and platform recognizable behind; lower area reserved for captions

actions: Subtle board illumination or small background station activity.
Use a scheduled departure display, not a present-time clock.
Lily does not appear in this early station cutaway.
needed_assets: regional train with windows and doors
critical_checks: 10:30 is clearly the departure time.
No current clock contradicts the next shot's home time of 9:00.
The train is recognizable rather than a featureless wall.

shots.speaker: Lily
shots.dialogue: It is nine o'clock now. I have time.
shots.location: Home: wall clock and Lily reaction
shots.visual: A clean clock insert shows 9:00, then Lily in a relaxed three-quarter view near the entry console. The room matches the first shot.

camera.type: clock detail followed by medium profile
camera.composition: Clock face unobstructed; reaction returns to the established home orientation

actions: Clock hour hand points to 9; minute hand to 12.
Lily gives a small relieved smile and calm nod, rather than checking anxiously.
critical_checks: Clock reads exactly 9:00.
The cut back home is unmistakable after the illustrative station insert.

shots.speaker: Lily
shots.dialogue: First, I need my phone and my wallet.
shots.location: Home: entry console and open small bag
shots.visual: An angled medium close-up links Lily's torso/hands with the phone, wallet and open bag. She collects what she needs with economical adult movement.

camera.composition: Phone, wallet and bag opening all visible in one working area; avoid cropping wrists

actions: Lily picks up the phone in her right hand.
She takes the wallet in her left hand and places it inside the bag.
The phone remains in her right hand for the next timetable shot.
needed_assets: small soft bag with real opening
critical_checks: The wallet does not teleport or reset outside the bag later.
Both hands have natural curved fingers and supported props.

shots.speaker: Lily
shots.dialogue: Here are the train times on my phone.
shots.visual: Phone in Lily's hand shows a simple timetable: Greenfield, departure 10:30, platform 2. The same case, hand and room maintain continuity.

camera.composition: Screen large enough for one glance; caption panel does not cover 10:30
camera.focus: screen and near fingers, sufficient depth for legibility

actions: A small thumb tap or glance confirms the service.
During the pause after the spoken phrase Lily places the phone back on the console, freeing her right hand.
critical_checks: The time and platform match the station board.
Phone is visibly set down before the bottle reach.

shots.speaker: Lily
shots.dialogue: Oh! I almost forgot my water bottle.
shots.visual: Lily notices the water bottle on an adjacent counter and turns toward it. The bottle is a normal 22–25 cm object, not a giant prop.

camera.type: medium three-quarter with bottle in same frame
camera.composition: Lily on one third, bottle on the opposite working side; eye line clearly connects to bottle
camera.focus: face and bottle; restrained depth blur

actions: Short recognition expression on Oh, then a small breath/smile.
Eyes lead the head turn toward the actual world-space bottle position.
Her right hand reaches and curls into a tested secure grip by the end of the shot.
needed_assets: adjacent counter connected to home layout
critical_checks: Gaze points toward the bottle.
No bottle lift occurs before contact.
Grasp is visible and physically aligned.

shots.speaker: Lily
shots.dialogue: I will put it inside my small bag.
shots.location: Home: bottle and small bag packing insert
shots.visual: Matched close-up of the same hand holding the bottle, moving it over the open bag, lowering it through the rim, and releasing only after it is supported.

camera.composition: Hand, bottle, bag opening and final seated state visible together; leave caption room below action
camera.focus: hand-to-bottle contact and bag rim throughout

actions: Maintain the bottle-to-hand relationship from the end of shot 8.
Lift smoothly, move over the opening without crossing a handle, then lower vertically.
Release fingers only when the bottle is seated; hand withdraws empty.
critical_checks: No floating or sliding bottle.
No hand through handle or bag wall.
Bottle ends inside and remains there for all later shots.
Do not use a portrait cut to hide a known incorrect grasp.

shots.speaker: Lily
shots.dialogue: My sister said, please arrive before lunch.
shots.location: Home: doorway, Anna message and final packing
shots.visual: A readable message from Anna says Please arrive before lunch. Lily reads it near the home doorway, then packs the phone, closes her small bag and lifts its strap.

camera.type: phone message insert into doorway medium
camera.composition: Message clear first; then face, bag and door establish readiness

actions: Lily picks up the phone with the now-free hand and reads Anna's message.
Phone goes inside the same bag with wallet and bottle.
Bag closes and Lily takes the strap; final body direction leads toward the door.
critical_checks: All three needed items are now packed.
No phone remains on the console in later home views.
Bag transfers to the chosen carrying hand without a discontinuous reset.

shots.speaker: Lily
shots.dialogue: I hope the train will be on time.
shots.location_role: present action after a clear journey/time montage cut
shots.visual: Lily stands safely on the platform with the same packed bag. Greenfield 10:30 is visible on the service display; a regional train is arriving slowly or already stopped, with daylight consistent with the home scene.

camera.composition: Lily at left third, recognizable train and platform depth to right; keep behind the platform safety line
camera.focus: Lily face with readable train context

actions: A clean location change implies elapsed travel time, rather than real-time teleportation.
Lily looks along the track/display with a hopeful, gentle expression.
Train is fully stopped before boarding begins; if a current clock is included it may read around 10:20, always before 10:30.
critical_checks: Lily's adult scale matches train door and platform architecture.
No bag-content or wardrobe reset.
No contradictory current time or moving open door.

shots.speaker: Lily
shots.dialogue: All right. I am ready. Let's go!
shots.visual: Beside an open stationary train door, Lily smiles, shifts her bag and steps aboard. Finish with her safely inside the vestibule or beside a visible passenger window; seats, floor and doorway make the train interior recognizable.

camera.type: three-quarter doorway medium, optional short interior reverse
camera.composition: Show weight-bearing foot/step in at least the tested boarding view; final face/bag remain in frame with passenger-train context

actions: A small ready nod on All right. I am ready.
On Let's go, Lily turns and takes a short tested step through the doorway, carrying the same bag.
End inside the train. Only show departure motion if she is fully aboard and doors are closed; a stationary interior ending is preferable to an unsafe or rushed departure.
critical_checks: No foot sliding, hovering or leg through step.
No train movement while Lily crosses the threshold.
Final caption and face remain legible; no abrupt freeze on a broken pose.
shots.lookdev_priority: required doorway/interior still and three-frame planted-step test
